title: Melee Component
description: Melee weapon behavior with attack patterns and hit detection.
content:
Melee Component

Melee weapon behavior with attack patterns, hit detection, and projectile deflection.

Component Weapon

Schema

JSON
"meleeComponent": {
  "hitBoxSize": 12.0,
  "attackDuration": 0.3,
  "canHit": true,
  "playerFriendly": true,
  "damage": 10,
  "deflection": { ... }
}

Description

The MeleeComponent defines melee weapon behavior including hitbox sizing, attack timing, damage, and projectile deflection. It handles close-range combat mechanics such as hit detection, damage application, and optional deflection of incoming projectiles during the attack window.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
hitBoxSizefloatSize of the melee attack hitbox in pixels.
attackDurationfloatDuration of the attack swing in seconds.
canHitboolWhether this melee weapon can deal damage to targets.
playerFriendlyboolIf true, the melee attack will not damage the player.
damageintBase damage dealt per hit.
deflectionDeflectionModelConfiguration for projectile deflection during melee attacks. When set, the weapon can deflect incoming projectiles.

Example

JSON — Sword with deflection
{
  "components": {
    "meleeComponent": {
      "hitBoxSize": 16.0,
      "attackDuration": 0.25,
      "canHit": true,
      "playerFriendly": true,
      "damage": 15,
      "deflection": {
        "enabled": true
      }
    }
  }
}
